scientific_integrity: The all-size assertion is proven by an equivariant quotient and constructive pair compression. Finite checks corroborate but do not certify the infinite theorem. No independent assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Minimum rank only; no exact shortest-word threshold. Unindexed equivalent earlier results remain a priority risk. The necklace counts use standard Möbius inversion.
title: Necklace-stabilizer classification of rank in partial-successor cyclic automata
